record.question:
Under the Mizoram Government’s support-price system for ginger, what happens when a farmer is
   unable to sell ginger at the government-declared support price?
options: The farmer receives no price support and must sell at the prevailing market price.
The Government imposes a ban on private procurement of ginger.
The Government provides the difference between the sale price and the declared support price.
The Government provides a fixed subsidy irrespective of the market price.
